jobs_results.title: AI & Backend Software Engineer – Intellectual Property Rights(Python / FastAPI / GenAI)
jobs_results.job_title: AI & Backend Software Engineer – Intellectual Property Rights(Python / FastAPI / GenAI)
jobs_results.description:
Company Description
 

    Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.



   Job Description
 

    Roles & Responsibilities :

   We are looking for a hands-on software engineer with intrinsic motivation to build and run Generative AI workflows for Bosch's global Intellectual Property (IP) organization.


 You will own workflows from start to finish. You will work directly with IP attorneys, patent analysts, and engineers to understand how they work. You will turn their problems into clear specifications and ship production tools with an AI-first engineering workflow. You will be responsible for specific workflows yourself and coordinate overall direction with the AI platform lead.


 The role is between our AI platform (Python / FastAPI) and our core enterprise IP Management applications. The scope grows with what AI makes possible and what our IP teams need, e.g. semantic search, automated document classification, portfolio intelligence, and strategic decision-support tools.


 What You Will Do


 
   Own workflows end to end: Work with internal users to understand their workflows, prototype and validate ideas in interactive UI frameworks, and bring what works into production, where users run it at scale from our core enterprise platforms, without a middleman.
   Build AI-powered backend services: Design and extend Python / FastAPI services that power IP workflows such as semantic search, automated document analysis, clustering, and structured information extraction.
   Design for the user: Care how the output is used: watch users work, cut steps, and make results easy to review and trust.
   Integrate with our IP Management System: Work with the enterprise applications team so their platform can trigger, consume AI workflows, and contribute on integration of APIs and web interfaces as required.
   Build data pipelines: Ingest and transform data from large-scale external databases and enterprise data platforms, handling rate limits, retries, pagination, and validation.
   Run what you build: Monitor quality, latency and LLM costs in production, and improve prompts, queries and architecture based on real user feedback.

 
 

 
Qualifications
 

    Educational qualification:


 
  B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA in Computer Science, IT or a related engineering field.
 
  Experience :


 
  3+ years of professional software engineering experience, mainly writing production backend code in Python.
 
  Mandatory/requires Skills :


 
  Experience building REST APIs (FastAPI preferred; Flask/Django acceptable), including async programming, Pydantic validation and authentication.
  Strong SQL skills with relational databases (e.g., Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server).
  Hands-on experience building LLM workflows via API (Gemini, Claude, GPT): context assembly, multi-step prompt chaining, embeddings/retrieval, and making output quality measurable and reproducible (evaluation sets, regression checks, tracing), whether outputs are free text or structured.
  Daily use of AI coding agents (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) with clear specs, and owning correctness: you decide where review and tests matter, and you verify behaviour before it reaches users.
  Solid Git / GitHub workflow (branches, pull requests, code review).
  Fluent English, written and spoken, for direct work with users and colleagues in Germany and worldwide.
 
  Preferred Skills :


 
  Exposure to patents or IP: patent data, claims, invention disclosures, and public/commercial patent databases, or being an inventor or patent agent yourself. We will gladly teach the IP domain to a strong engineer.
  Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., Angular/TypeScript), interactive data prototyping tools (e.g., Streamlit), or enterprise data lakehouses (e.g., Databricks/PySpark).
  Experience running services on Windows Server (PowerShell, scheduled tasks).
 
  Scope note: This is a software engineering role. Not patent searching, project management or BI dashboarding role.

jobs_results.description: Senior Python Developer – Backend, AI/ML & RAG Senior Python Developer – Backend, AI/ML & RAG Experience: 8+ years in software development, with strong Python backend expertise and hands-on experience delivering AI/ML applications. About Team Our team builds enterprise applications that combine robust backend engineering with AI-powered experiences. We develop intelligent assistants, knowledge-retrieval solutions, and workflow automation that integrate with enterprise platforms and services. We are looking for a senior developer who can translate business requirements into secure, scalable applications, guide technical design, and take ownership from development through production support. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable Python backend services, REST APIs, and service-to-service integrations. Build AI-powered applications using large language models (LLMs), agent frameworks, and machine learning capabilities. Develop end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines covering document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing, retrieval, and grounded response generation. Implement prompt engineering, agent workflows, tool calling, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. Integrate enterprise knowledge sources and applications, including ITSM platforms, Confluence, SharePoint, and enterprise APIs. Evaluate AI solutions for accuracy, groundedness, hallucinations, retrieval quality, latency, and cost. Build automated functional, integration, regression, performance, and AI evaluation tests. Lead technical design discussions and code reviews; document architecture, APIs, and implementation decisions. Troubleshoot complex application, API, integration, and production issues, and implement sustainable fixes. Improve application performance, reliability, observability, and model/token efficiency. Apply secure coding practices, access controls, privacy safeguards, and enterprise AI governance requirements. Collaborate with product, QA, engineering, and business stakeholders to define requirements and delivery priorities. Mentor engineers and improve development practices across the software development lifecycle. Support production operations, dependency upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and application maintenance. Mandatory Skills Python and backend engineering: Strong hands-on Python expertise, including asynchronous programming, exception handling, testing, and maintainable application design. API development: Experience building production APIs using FastAPI, Flask, Django, or a comparable framework; strong understanding of authentication, authorization, versioning, and error handling. Backend architecture: Experience designing scalable services, managing concurrency, and implementing caching, background processing, retries, and resilient integrations. Data management: Strong SQL and relational database skills, with experience in data modelling, query optimisation, and application data access. LLM application development: Hands-on experience integrating LLMs into applications, including prompt design, structured outputs, tool calling, and failure handling. RAG and retrieval: Practical experience with embeddings, vector databases or vector search, chunking strategies, metadata filtering, and retrieval optimisation. ML fundamentals: Understanding of model inference, data preparation, evaluation metrics, and the distinction between model quality and application performance. AI evaluation: Ability to build repeatable evaluations for retrieval relevance, response quality, groundedness, latency, and cost. Security and privacy: Experience protecting sensitive data, managing secrets, enforcing access controls, and addressing prompt injection and unsafe tool execution. Production delivery: Experience with cloud deployment, containers, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting. Technical leadership: Ability to lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and communicate technical decisions clearly. Good to Have Skills Experience with OCI or other major cloud platforms. Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent tools. Hands-on experience building or integrating MCP servers and clients. Experience with hybrid search, reranking, query rewriting, and permission-aware enterprise retrieval. Experience with Slack APIs, Jira Service Management, chatbots, and IT service-management workflows. Familiarity with proactive support, ticket routing, and self-healing automation. Experience with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and distributed tracing. Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, model adaptation or fine-tuning, and model-serving platforms. Familiarity with AI auditability, data residency, and enterprise governance controls. Self Assessment Questions Do I have 8+ years of software development experience , with strong hands-on expertise in Python backend development? Can I independently design and build scalable APIs, backend services, and enterprise integrations? Have I built AI/ML or LLM-powered applications with end-to-end RAG pipelines , including embeddings and vector search? Can I test, secure, deploy, and support these applications in production while improving response quality, performance, and cost? Am I comfortable owning technical delivery, leading design and code reviews, and mentoring engineers? Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute.
